productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Join bestselling mouse-author Geronimo Stilton on three daring adventures around the world!._**

Join bestselling mouse-author Geronimo Stilton on three daring adventures around the world! He’ll find secret treasure with his sister Thea, discover the Great Cheese Pyramid in Egypt, and stumble upon a spooky castle - haunted by cats!  
  
  
  
  
This pack includes:  
  
  
  
  
Geronimo Stilton: Book 1 - Lost Treasure of the Emerald Eye  
  
  
  
  
Geronimo Stilton: Book 2 - The Curse of the Cheese Pyramid  
  
  
  
  
Geronimo Stilton: Book 3 - Cat and Mouse in a Haunted House

Tracks included:

*   Late Again!
*   Thea's Secret
*   Cheap Junk for Less
*   Take Me with You
*   Anything Missing?
*   First Dawn at Sea
*   Fresh Clams, Anyone?

*    The Trunk Of Many Wonders

*   Laaaaand Ho!
*   Emerald-Green
*   Line Up!
*   From My Diary

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
